question.content:
The Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub biome has dry summers and mild, rainy winters. This biome is found all over the world, including the Mediterranean Basin, Baja California Peninsula, South Africa, and Australia. Plants in this biome are tough and woody; some even have waxy leaves to reduce water loss during the hot, dry summer.

[[☃ image 1]]

**Which of the following graphs best matches the climate of the Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub biome?**

[[☃ explanation 1]]

[[☃ radio 1]]

[[☃ explanation 2]]

options.explanation: In the graphs shown below, monthly total precipitation (in millimeters) is indicated by bars and is measured on the left-hand *y*-axis of the graph. Monthly average temperature (in degrees Celsius) is indicated by a dotted line and is measured on the right-hand *y*-axis of the graph. Each month is labeled on the *x*-axis.

choices.clue: The Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub biome has hot, dry summers and mild, rainy winters. This graph does show high temperatures during the summer months (in June, July, and August). However, it does *not* show a substantial decrease in precipitation during the summer months compared to the rest of the year.
